trickyParts: The line-start scan walks back by hand: lastIndexOf('\r') with no CR in the source scans to offset 0, which would be quadratic across many directives.
A dispatchMark wrapper has no position, so the floor takes the end of its last child (sourceEnd); without it a quote line ':::' inside a mark span was drawn twice.
